scope: Explicit sealed catalogue publication or effective CG of retained READY pro1. No global-latest raw facts,body or wall clock. Hash actual model primary keys and selected typed fields including all plausible ambiguity candidates.

relations.selection: Exact sealed catalogue witness; knowledge_cutoff_at controls dated tenure. No fabricated cutoff from wall time or retrieval timestamp.
Exact catalogue-admitted scoped source document membership.
Exact registered source IDs/codes (wikidata,uefa and identity-checked honour provider).
Scoped dataset keys/contracts and actual public attribution.
Immutable content hash,source,dataset,retrieved-at and source provenance URL; exclude physical storage/retention.
Exact actor external key,record kind,document,ordinal/locator and same source,including honours identity root.
Team/player public aliases atCG; exact target ownership,never names-as-identifiers.
Exact active Wikidata QID/UEFA decimal external-ID candidates atCG for scoped team; raw text/leading zeros preserved.
Same-source wiki enrichment/UEFA display/honours contexts,source:exact variant and pinnedCG; all candidates,not preferred global profile.
Exact same-source alias candidate,explicit language/country/validity context; no fuzzy identity match.
Selected country atCG for typed team profile,when provided; native country_code_source retained.
All plausible same-source head-coach observations atCG with role,dated bounds,precision and observed_at; NULL upper bound remains unknown.
Selected exact coach identity revision atCG and linked image asset,not photo-based disambiguation.
Same-source exact coach QID binding and provenance atCG.
Selected exact venue atCG,capacity/observed date/coordinates/opened_year only. No official home-stadium or plans invention.
Exact same-source Wikidata QID/venue revision binding atCG.
Exact scoped player winning and other observed outcomes,edition_key and source pointer,selected atCG.
Exact selected definition and individual/team category atCG.
Explicit selected competition season only where a qualified honour references it; don't parse opaque edition_key.
Exact linked asset and all rows sharing legacy alias before ambiguity refusal; current key/hash/MIME/author/license/credit/alias changes alter metadata witness.

note: Module uses no mutable stable team name as historical fallback. The model cannot express official team→home venue,stadium plans or venue creation date; expose explicit unrecorded states. Root owns shared publisher release integration.
